agent_priors_used: Path dependence and context salience: agents overweight recently seen families/templates (add_to_cart duplication 0.9479) and under-explore mixed header+body+query+auth compositions — explains 10/10 header+body vs 0/10 auth/mixed ceiling; prior used to require correct-family gating and mixed composition test, not as SPIDER evidence.

Local-optimum trapping via repeated kernel micro-tuning (prefix, Jaccard, field-path filter) optimizes synthetic harness reward without changing live-browser distribution — justifies parking further synthetic parameterization loops and forcing single-family live pilot with Wilson bounds and honest cost.

Tool/API bypass higher leverage than UI replay when action space is header/body/query+auth: API route catalog (Unbrowse/WebMCP) reduces exploration from ODOM to O endpoints, more stable under DOM drift — motivates compile-and-execute vs retrieval Pareto.

Caching/replay baselines must be strong: exact replay, selector cache, nearest trajectory, RAG k=5, Stagehand cache+heal, API-route cache are cheaper competitors SPIDER must beat, not cold only — requires per_hit <=0.85 vs RAG and <=1.20 vs Stagehand at n=0.

Long-horizon compounding errors without intermediate verification inflate later-agent cost independent of true novelty fraction — justifies mandatory verify()/UNKNOWN abstention (ECE<=0.15, precision>=0.85) before attributing cost to residual novelty.
